kernels.notes: SYCL kernel (dsv4_hc.cpp:comb) implemented. 4x4 combination matrix with softmax+Sinkhorn normalization. 3/3 tests PASS on B70.
SYCL kernel (dsv4_hc.cpp:pre) implemented. Per-head weighted sum across HC dimension. 4/4 tests PASS on B70.
SYCL kernel (dsv4_hc.cpp:post) implemented. Fused residual+combination-weighted sum. 3/3 tests PASS on B70.

SYCL kernel implemented using 1D nd_range with register-only FWHT. Uses sycl::permute_group_by_xor for intra-subgroup butterfly. Sizes: 64, 128, 256, 512. Other sizes fall back to standard MUL_MAT path. 9/9 tests pass on B70.
Already exists in SYCL backend as k_compute_batched_ptrs in ggml-sycl.cpp:3404. No migration needed.
SYCL kernel (opt_step_sgd.cpp) created. Element-wise SGD step: x[i] = x[i]*(1-wd*lr) - lr*g[i]. PASSED on B70.
SYCL kernel (opt_step_adamw.cpp) created. Full AdamW with m/v buffers+bias correction. PASSED on B70.
Fused kernel replacing 5-element chain. Equivalent to standard element-wise ops but fused for performance. Can be emulated via 5 separate element-wise ops (already in SYCL). [Existing SYCL backend]
NOT a standalone GGML_OP. SOFTCAP is a fusion of SCALE+TANH+SCALE handled individually in SYCL backend. Fused kernel (softcap.cpp) created for future fusion optimization.

Vector kernel with shared memory + warp shuffle. Supports F16/Q4_0 K types, n_embd=128, n_head=32/64. 18/24 tests pass: F16 12/12 OK, Q4_0 nb>=512 6/6 OK, Q4_0 nb=1 0/6 FAIL (known stride/layout issue).
